screens.label: Discussion — Round 3, clue turn 2
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Revise the supplied IMPOSTER mobile mockup for a MULTIPLE CLUE TURNS mechanic inside one game round. Generate ONE standalone portrait screen in exactly the same slim black Android phone frame, matte charcoal #141916, ivory #F4F1E8, sage #B4C8AD, lime #D6F56B, typography, initials avatars, tactile eye-card art and polished spacing as the reference. Preserve the established app theme and device presentation, not a redesign. Keep all text readable with 16px logical body and 14px secondary minimum; app viewport about 393x852. Distinguish round number from clue-turn number. Role and secret word stay the same through turns; never show private roles or secret word on a public screen. Each player can optionally save ONE clue for EACH turn. Earlier turns remain visible and unchanged. Blank entries are silently absent, never show missing/awaiting/required labels, completion counters, ready gates or a guess-readiness poll. All history is cleared only when the NEXT GAME ROUND starts, not between clue turns. No timer, no bottom navigation, no charts, no decorative gradients. Complete unclipped phone on a neutral dark backdrop with small equal margins, no multi-screen collage.
Update the discussion screen. Appbar back arrow, "Round 3 · Turn 2", eye and QR icons. Keep headline "Who sounds suspicious?" and shorter supporting copy "Need more clues? Keep talking." Keep the eye-card artwork as a SMALL 60px logical height landscape accent, freeing room for the new turn controls. Flat roster section title "Clues by turn", secondary copy "Optional · clears next round."
Show four player rows, flat dividers, no surrounding cards:
AL lime avatar, "Alex · You" plus crown; a small historical line "Turn 1: Umbrella"; below a clearly tappable underlined action "Add clue for turn 2". Do not show an empty current-turn warning.
MI terracotta avatar, "Mia"; two short text entries "Turn 1: Rain" and "Turn 2: Puddle", set compactly in two lines.
BE sage avatar, "Ben"; just "Turn 1: Boots". Ben has not entered anything for turn 2; do not label this.
SA sage avatar, "Sam"; just "Turn 2: Storm". Sam skipped turn 1; do not label this.
At bottom show TWO full-width host actions, both enabled: outline secondary button "Another clue turn" followed by lime primary button "Open voting". These are the key new controls: host can start turn 3 if the group wants more clues, or vote now without requiring any entries. Omit the previous bottom Pause round text action in this focused review mockup to keep these two controls visible. Keep full layout comfortably inside the phone. Use generous but calibrated spacing, no dense table or horizontal scroll. Both clue turns belong to Round 3.
